Comitant
Angle of misalignment unchanged with direction of gaze

  • Accommodative Esotropia (onset 2-4yrs, hyperopic)
  • Congenital Esotropia (contralateral eye deviates medial → straight when ipsilateral covered)
  • Exotropia (contralateral eye deviates lateral → straight when ipsilateral covered)

Eso/exotropia, hyper/hypotropia, mixed

  • CN III Problem (eye is depressed and abducted, ptosis, large/unreactive pupil)
  • CN IV Problem (eye cannot depress when looking medially)
